REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - MAY 13, 2004 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
Consent Calendar
7.
Registers of Demands dated 5/13/2004
8.
Approval of Treasurer's Reports for period ending 1/31/2004, 2/29/2004 and 3/3/2004
9.
Minutes of 4/20/2004
10.
Ordinances for second reading and adoption. Reading of ordinances waived and ordinances adopted
10A.
Ordinance 881 adding Sections 15.04.130 and 15.04.140 to the Cerritos Municipal Code for the purpose of establishing regulations pertaining to the timely commencement and completion of projects authorized by Precise Plans, Conditional Use Permits or building permits
10B.
Ordinance No. 882 amending Chapter 22.70, Development Standards, of the Cerritos Municipal Code relating to the regulation of paint color, material, and treatment of residential building exteriors as well as walls and fences
10C.
Ordinance No. 883 amending Chapter 9.48 of the Cerritos Municipal Code to define a tent and to restrict the type of tent or shelfter that can be erected in public parks
End of Consent Calendar
11.
Public Hearings
11A.
A joint resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos and the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency approving changes to the residential assistance program (G-RAP)
11B.
A joint resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos and the Cerritos Redevelopment AGency approving the implementation of an owner-occupied residential rehabilitation loan assistance program (L-RAP)
12.
Pending Legal Matters
12A.
An ordinance amending Title 9, Chapter 9.48 of the Cerritos Municipal Code regarding dogs and cats in parks
12B.
A resolution authorizing the City of Cerritos to participate in a regional application to the California Integrated Waste Management Board for funding of a household hazardous waste grant for fiscal year 2004/2005
12C.
Assessment for Los Coyotes Lighting and Landscaping District. Presentation of Engineer's Report. A resolution approving the engineer's report regarding the annual levy of assessments within the Los Coyotes Lighting and Landscaping District, declaring its intention to order and implement a reassessment beginning 7/1/2004 and setting a public hearing date of 6/10/2004
13.
New and Old Business
13A.
Agreement with the California Franchise Tax Board under the Local Government Sharing Program authorized by Assembly Bill 63
13B.
Award of Bid No. 974-04, purchase of one new van
Recess
Reconvene
13C.
Artwork to be located at the southeast corner of Artesia Boulevard and Carmenita Road (13400 Artesia Boulevard) for Adonis and Maria Cristina C. Lat in accordance with Chapter 22.94 of the Cerritos Municipal Code as it relates to the Art in Public Places Program
13D.
Artwork to be located at the northeast corner of Del Amo Boulevard and Pioneer Boulevard for Union Development Corporation in accordance with Chapter 22.94 of the Cerritos Municipal Code as it relates to the Art in Public Places Program
13E.
Artwork to be located on the north side of Artesia Boulevard between Studebaker Road and the San Gabriel Flood Control Channel (10753 Artesia Boulevard) for Union Development Corporation in accordance with Chapter 22.94 of the Cerritos Municipal Code as it relates to the Art in Public Places Program
14.
Report on pending legislation
15.Ci
ty Council Communications/Committee Reports
16.Ad
journment
